snippet.title: Berserker 2: The Saga of Hilde - Launch trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3535600

A dark Nordic saga continues.

Berserker 2: The Saga of Hilde is a short, story-driven action adventure set in a world where grief turns into fury and fury awakens something far older than men.

You play as Asbjorn, a warrior bound by loss, hunting those who shattered his family. What begins as a personal quest slowly reveals a greater, supernatural threat lurking beneath the old gods and forgotten lands.

Brutal, grounded combat
Dark, atmospheric Nordic world
Narrative-driven experience
Multiple playable characters
2–3 hour focused story journey

This is not a power fantasy.
This is a descent.

Release: February 13, 2026
Developed by One Life Games

Wishlist on Steam and follow the saga.
